title: Prevent reversal of outbound inventory still referenced by approved loading
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Before cancelling or reversing approved outbound inventory resolve current real stock-out authorization/customer scope and check effective approved nondeleted loading details explicitly linked through StockOutDetailId. Reject reversal with actionable loading reversal requirement before changing status/stock/ledger. Null-source legacy loading, pending/cancelled/deleted loading and unrelated details do not block; do not guess via product or document numbers. Authorized historical reads preserve all evidence.

Use exactly the same stock-out row lock/order and atomic transaction as loading approval and existing ERP359 return cancellation guard. Two actual controller connections racing loading approval against stock-out cancellation produce one consistent serialized result; cancelled loading releases the guard while its evidence remains preserved. Repeat cancellation remains idempotent and later inventory reversal failure rolls back all changes. Do not prohibit legitimate post-shipment sales returns or rewrite loading historical quantities; subsequent loading capacity accounts for those returns. Validate actual controllers on dedicated SQL including denial unchanged stock/ledger, release, race and existing return guards.

implementation_evidence: StockOutController.Cancel protects approved SalesReturn references but cannot inspect physical loading links because those were absent. Once explicit linked loading exists, source reversal must share its locking boundary.
